title: Putting calendars in order
question: Calendar Managers set one order for the church's calendars: on the left here, in Browse calendars and on the phone. How should they move them? (3 of 4)

options.label: Drag by a handle
options.thesis: A handle appears on hover or focus; drag a calendar into place, or press Alt ↑ / Alt ↓. It saves straight away.
materials: drag lift and a drop line
options.viewport: The calendar list as today, a grip at each row's left on hover, the moving one lifted with an aqua line where it will land.
options.risk: Nothing on screen says it can be dragged until you hover.

options.label: Arrange, then Done
options.thesis: An Arrange button turns the list into ordering: handles and up and down arrows on every row, switches hidden, Done to finish.
options.viewport: The list's head reads 'Order on phones and here' with Done; each calendar has a handle and arrows.
options.risk: One more click before you can move anything.
